name: brasta-online
description: Server-authoritative online Brasta for Vercel WebSockets + Redis

scripts.build:client: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.release-tests.json
scripts.build: npm run sync:engine && npm run build:client && npm run verify:rules && npm run build:server-tests && npm run verify:online && next build
scripts.test:rules: npm run build:client && npm run verify:rules
scripts.test:online: npm run sync:engine && npm run build:server-tests && npm run verify:online
